title: Cisco Industrial Ethernet HSR Ring Faults
exclusions: Catalyst IE switches running IOS XE only. The alarm must be enabled for syslog with the alarm facility command. Other IOS devices that emit the same mnemonic will also match.
evidence: The latest state per switch for 30 days, and a ticket when a fault is not cleared.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Shut one ring port on a lab IE switch. The guide's example syslog is `%HSR_ALARM-3-HSR_PARTIALFAULT`. The switch appears with state partial_fault.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Clear the fault. The next syslog contains the documented 'event cleared' text or the mnemonic stops, and the switch drops off the open list.

dataSources: `index=network sourcetype=cisco:ios` from Catalyst IE3x00, IE3400 Heavy Duty, and ESS3300 switches, parsed by the IOS XE syslog add-on (Splunkbase 7538). Cisco documents `%HSR_ALARM-3-HSR_PARTIALFAULT` and `%HSR_ALARM-2-HSR_RINGFAULT`, including an 'event cleared' form.
spl:
index=network sourcetype="cisco:ios" earliest=-24h
("%HSR_ALARM-2-HSR_RINGFAULT" OR "%HSR_ALARM-3-HSR_PARTIALFAULT")
| eval state=case(match(_raw, "event cleared"), "cleared", match(_raw, "HSR_RINGFAULT"), "ring_fault", true(), "partial_fault")
| stats latest(state) as state by host
| where state!="cleared"
description: Lists Catalyst IE switches whose latest High-availability Seamless Redundancy syslog is an open ring fault or partial fault. Cisco's HSR guide shows the messages %HSR_ALARM-2-HSR_RINGFAULT and %HSR_ALARM-3-HSR_PARTIALFAULT, and the same messages with 'event cleared' when the alarm ends.
value: A ring that has lost one or both paths is one failure away from stopping the process network. This list is the switches still in that state, so the spare path is repaired before the second failure.
implementation: Send IOS XE syslog from the IE switches to Splunk with the IOS XE syslog add-on (Splunkbase 7538), sourcetype cisco:ios, index=network. Enable the alarm facility syslog commands in the redundancy guide. Alert on rows that are not cleared.
visualization: Table of host and state. A single value counts switches that are not cleared.

references.title: Configuring Precision Time Protocol, Catalyst IE3x00

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Planned ring or clock maintenance** — a change window produces the same mnemonic. Match the host to the change ticket before paging.

2. **Other IOS XE devices** — a non-IE switch that emits the same mnemonic appears here. Restrict host to the IE inventory if that happens.

**Suppression:** suppress hosts that are in a recorded maintenance window.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunkbase 7538 (IOS XE syslog) on the indexer or heavy forwarder that receives syslog.
• Catalyst IE3x00, IE3400 Heavy Duty, or ESS3300 switches running IOS XE, with syslog aimed at Splunk and sourcetype cisco:ios.
• For HSR, `alarm facility hsr syslog` on the switch, from the HSR configuration guide. PTP and PRP messages are IOS XE system messages once those features are configured.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
• Confirm one switch is visible: `index=network sourcetype=cisco:ios host=<ie-switch> | head 5`.
• Confirm the mnemonic: `index=network sourcetype=cisco:ios "%HSR_ALARM-3-HSR_PARTIALFAULT"`.

Step 2 — Create the search
```spl
index=network sourcetype="cisco:ios" earliest=-24h
("%HSR_ALARM-2-HSR_RINGFAULT" OR "%HSR_ALARM-3-HSR_PARTIALFAULT")
| eval state=case(match(_raw, "event cleared"), "cleared", match(_raw, "HSR_RINGFAULT"), "ring_fault", true(), "partial_fault")
| stats latest(state) as state by host
| where state!="cleared"
```

Understanding this SPL
• The search matches the mnemonic text Cisco prints in the syslog example, not a parsed field. The IOS XE syslog add-on does not publish a field for these alarms.
• `event cleared` is the text Cisco appends when the alarm clears, shown in the HSR syslog examples.

Step 3 — Validate
Shut one ring port on a lab IE switch. The guide's example syslog is `%HSR_ALARM-3-HSR_PARTIALFAULT`. The switch appears with state partial_fault.
• Compare the host with the switch name in the facility-alarm output on the CLI.

• Confirm in the vendor console that the same hour shows the same kind of event before trusting a zero or a spike.

Step 4 — Operationalize
• Run every 5 minutes. Page when a host stays in a fault state for two intervals.
• Show uncleared hosts on the plant-network dashboard.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting
• Other IOS syslog arrives but not this mnemonic: `alarm facility hsr syslog` is not configured, so the switch never sends the ring alarm.
• Nothing arrives: syslog is not reaching the input, or the sourcetype was left as syslog instead of cisco:ios.
• No data for sourcetype cisco:ios, with an input error on the syslog receiver, means the switch is not sending or the receiver is down.
grandmaExplanation: We list factory switches whose backup network ring is broken and has not healed.
